purpose: Probe whether longer repeated-step XuanTie-E902 work can amortize host/device communication enough to justify a true memory-resident runtime path.
preconditions: XuanTie-E902 GPU cubin and meta are present under artifacts/xuantie_e902_obj_dir
artifacts/ and reports/ are ignored generated outputs

correctness_policy.baseline: one-state normalized CPU/GPU final-state equivalence plus prior large-workload CPU/GPU timing surface
batched_gpu_runs: dumped state byte size equals storage_size * nstates when dump is requested
resident mode rejects per-step host patch inputs
no memory-resident speedup claim is made until a matching CPU exact-loop baseline exists

non_claims: this is the first explicit resident-step runtime gate, but not proof of broad fully resident GPU runtime generality
no XuanTie speedup claim until a matching memory-resident CPU exact-loop baseline exists
no full non-TL-UL generality claim from one E902 wrapper
